findings.ac: Follow-up: re-invocation after a Path A pause resumes at 2b
findings.text: 2z Phase 0 resume detection (PRD exists -> Phase 2; design status: stable or skip-path planned -> Phase 3) is only pinned by test_2z_phase_0_loads_memory_once_and_detects_resume asserting the literals 'docs/prds/BT-<padded>-*.md' and 'status: stable'; no assertion ties the PRD-exists case to Phase 2 or the stable/planned case to Phase 3 (the 'promoted the epic to `planned`' skip-path literal is untested), so a swapped or dropped mapping would still pass. The Phase 2 test checks '/2z-write-spec BT-<n>' and 'resum' but not that the resume lands at 2b.

findings.ac: Follow-up: 2c's scan runs in its isolated auditor
findings.text: test_2z_phase_3_runs_2c_in_main_thread_and_keeps_edits_uncommitted asserts 'main thread', 'Do **not** wrap' and 'uncommitted' only; nothing asserts the Phase 3 text that 2c's Context Isolation Rule isolates the scan to the Spec-Reconciliation Auditor subagent, so removing that sentence would not fail any test.

Decision-log requirements (append one line per HITL decision, rename .tmp/2z-<slug>-decisions.md to the BT-<padded> name after 2a mints the ID, resume and hand-off read it) are only covered by the two path literals in Phase 0; the rename and append behaviors and the Phase 4 mention of the decision log path are not asserted.

findings.ac: Logic Layer: Depth <=2 and Phase 4 same hand-off routing as 2b
findings.text: test_2z_phase_4_routes_like_2b_and_states_the_depth_budget uses 'assert "2 levels" in text or "depth" in text.lower()', which passes on any occurrence of the word 'depth' (the '**Depth:**' label) so the <=2 budget wording is not pinned; Phase 4 only checks names '/3a-version-planning' and '/3b-create-issue', not the 'only when 3a would act' routing or that the hand-off names the uncommitted 2c edits.

findings.ac: Logic Layer Phase 0: load-memory once, units' own Phase 0 load-memory satisfied
findings.text: The Phase 0 test asserts only 'load-memory' and 'once' substrings in Phase 0; the required statement that the units' own Phase 0 load-memory is already satisfied (skip it) is not asserted.

findings.ac: Registration: setup SKILL.md '22 bundled skills' x3 -> 23, README 26 -> 27
findings.text: test_2z_registered_in_check_suite_and_docs asserts only one occurrence each ('23 bundled skills' in stratosphere-setup/SKILL.md; '27 skills' in README.md), while the issue names three setup SKILL.md edits (lines with 'All 23 bundled skills' x3, plus the '23 lifecycle skills' suite-check line) and two README edits; a regression leaving any other occurrence at 22/26 would still pass. The stale '# The 22 Layer 1 skills' comment in src/scripts/check_suite.py also remains.
